historical_reviews.v3_1: Wistron I2C defaults to BMC/platform-management scope. ED-04 allows a conditional fan-board read plan after channel mapping, safe-register and thermal-oracle inputs are bound.

original_test_intent: Validate the FAN_BD management-I2C connection by confirming the expected fan controller, tachometer and temperature-sensor resources while preserving automatic cooling control.
original_method: After the owner maps the fan board, controller, mux path, fan channels and sensors and approves read-only registers plus thermal limits, collect topology, tach/status/temperature and platform-health evidence without changing fan control.
manual_activity: The thermal/platform owner maps FAN_BD channels to physical fans and sensors, approves read-only status evidence and thermal aborts, and separately identifies any project-required physical inspection.
required_inputs: BMC/OOB controller, mux and bus route
Fan channel to physical position mapping
Expected controller and sensor target addresses
Read-only identity, tach, status and temperature register allowlist
Explicit exclusions for PWM, mode, watchdog and fault-clear writes
Independent cooling/power recovery and thermal abort thresholds
safety_requirements: Do not infer fan unplugging or continuity measurement from FAN_BD
Do not scan unknown controllers or addresses
Do not write PWM, fan mode, watchdog, fault-clear or power-control registers
Do not disable automatic cooling or mask faults
Continuously monitor all fan tach and critical temperatures
Stop on fan loss, RPM drop, thermal rise, bus lock, controller reset or BMC reachability anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Validate the management route and read allowlist
After approval, collect identity, tach, status and temperature evidence only
Correlate every channel with a physical fan and thermal zone
Perform no physical manipulation or fan-control write
engineer_actions: Bind board, controller, fan and sensor topology
Approve safe reads and expected ranges

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command is supplied, so current execution is correctly withheld. The derived physical-continuity claim is unsupported; a logical FAN_BD test is possible only with an owner-approved channel/register contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented BMC/OOB fan-controller interface to read only allowlisted identity, tach, status and temperature fields for the mapped FAN_BD channels while monitoring thermal health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FAN_BD, TBD procedure/criteria and two-minute planning fields are retained; no fan index, bus, address, register, RPM or temperature limit is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES FAN_BOARD I2C PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture baseline fan/tach/temperature state, traverse the documented BMC mux route, read mapped controller resources without changing control, compare presence/RPM/status/temperature with the project oracle, then verify automatic fan policy and thermal state are unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines conditional logical verification while preserving Master TBD and excluding inferred physical actions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readback proves the approved management path and controller resources, not fan connector seating, airflow or electrical continuity if separately required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Even a short wrong-register access can change PWM or controller mode, stop cooling and damage CPUs, GPUs or power components.

project_override_considerations: Any physical fan-board action requires a separate thermal-safe plan and qualified operator. Logical readback must not be used as permission to unplug fans or as proof of airflow/mechanical condition.
expected_evidence: Exact FAN_BD source and project applicability
Before/after fan policy, RPM, critical temperatures, BMC SEL/SDR and platform health
Thermal abort/recovery audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: TBD method and criterion are missing rather than contradictory. The physical-continuity description comes from prior reviews, not the Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: FAN_BD names a management target whose identity, tach, status and sensor reads can form a deterministic test after project mapping. Missing registers, ranges and topology are readiness inputs under ED-04.

review_improvement: Reframes the case around fan-controller resource visibility and thermal invariants, rejects an unsupported manual-only core, and explicitly prohibits PWM/control writes that could convert evidence collection into a cooling fault.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fan-board connectivity is meaningful only when each controller channel maps to a real fan or sensor and its readback is plausible for the current thermal state. A generic bus response is insufficient, but a physical continuity assumption is also unsupported. Exact read-only channel evidence with continuous thermal guards makes the operation conditionally automatable.
